Hidden Gems // Field Guide

How To Use This Board

Read This In 10 Seconds
Start with the score, then check the three columns below it: Trait tells you what is strong, Divergence tells you what the market may still be missing, and Market tells you how early the profile may still be.
Hidden Gem
A player whose underlying profile looks stronger than the public-facing results and current market attention suggest.
Latent Alpha
Unpriced upside. This appears when strong underlying indicators have not fully translated into broad market belief.
Ballistic Breakout
A profile where movement, shape, impact quality, or damage support points toward a stronger future result set than the current surface line implies.
Divergence
The gap between stronger underlying traits and weaker visible outcomes. This is the core Hidden Gems lens.
Under-the-Hood Elite
A player whose deeper support metrics look stronger than their current public perception or box-score line.
Trait
The quality of the underlying profile. For pitchers this may include carry, whiff support, and velocity. For hitters this may include impact, power shape, and damage support.
Divergence Score
A measure of how much the current visible results still lag the deeper profile.
Market Score
A rough estimate of how early the market still appears to be relative to the player’s underlying quality.
Ballistics vs Surface
This area frames the relationship between rising skill support and slower-moving public results. It is meant to help you spot profiles where the market may still be late.
How To Use This Board
Use this page to find buy-low candidates, not already-obvious stars. The best names here usually combine good underlying support, visible underperformance, and still-manageable market attention.
